=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:104-132 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: poller_claude_judge overwrites callers’ AI_ENGINE_READ_ONLY=true setting, so STALL_JUDGE and RB_JUDGE run with write-capable tools instead of the requested read-only profile.
  WHY: These judges consume untrusted issue and PR content; severity was rated BLOCKER by DeepSeek, Gemini, and Minimax, and MAJOR by OpenAI.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:104-132 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: poller_claude_judge does not forward the resolved role’s read profile for SECURITY_AUDIT, SECURITY_JUDGE, and explicit read-only verdicts.
  WHY: These roles can run with Edit/Write/Bash tools enabled despite their read-profile contract.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6550 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The SECURITY_AUDIT invocation does not forward the read profile to poller_claude_judge.
  WHY: SECURITY_AUDIT consequently inherits the default write profile and broader tool access than intended.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1753-1758, 1788-1790 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: An unresolved git commit directory only emits a warning, so the guard checks the session checkout’s branch and PR status instead of requesting confirmation.
  WHY: The commit may target another worktree whose merged-PR status is not checked; severity was rated BLOCKER by DeepSeek and OpenAI, and MAJOR by Gemini.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1590-1593 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The referenced LAST RUN DIFF uses invocation.config_override, which is not a field in _GitInvocation.
  WHY: If that hunk is applied, the guard would raise AttributeError; severity was rated BLOCKER by Gemini and Qwen, and MAJOR by DeepSeek.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1590-1593 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The referenced LAST RUN DIFF uses invocation.config_override, which is not a field in the workflow-template copy’s _GitInvocation.
  WHY: If that hunk is applied, the template guard would raise AttributeError.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1452-1472 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still expects ask behavior for all parameterized commands instead of asserting the described deny/block behavior for GIT_CONFIG_* commands.
  WHY: The test does not exercise the intended configuration-override denial path; severity was rated BLOCKER by DeepSeek, Minimax, and Qwen, and MAJOR by Gemini.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1419-1433 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still expects ask for all listed -c and --config-env commands rather than the intended block behavior.
  WHY: The test would not verify the block path described by the LAST RUN DIFF.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: An unresolved `env -C` commit directory must request confirmation instead of consulting the session checkout’s PR history.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, _evaluate_bash
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Both hook copies lack the commit-specific confirmation path; _evaluate_bash creates a _GuardTarget without forwarding config_uncertain, so the unresolved commit reaches the warning-only path and can query the session checkout’s PR history. README.md:1123-1124, agents.md:18, and changelog.d/6263-push-guard-destination-repo.md:6 document the behavior.
- requirement: Configuration-overridden push commands should be blocked with code 2 and a “push configuration overrides” message for the specified inline and environment configuration cases, with tests verifying those outcomes.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, _evaluate_bash; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs and test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The production guard routes config_uncertain through the confirmation path rather than the described deny path; the tests still assert ask for the parameterized -c/--config-env and GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL cases.
- requirement: The changes introduced in the LAST RUN DIFF to address PR #6434 must be fully applied and verified.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py around line 1593; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py around the same area; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py at lines 1452-1472
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `grep -F config_override` returns no hits in either hook copy; `grep -F 'if invocation.subcommand == "commit"'` returns no hits; test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts the old ask-JSON behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:115-119; callers at lines 15142, 21727 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: poller_claude_judge sets AI_ENGINE_READ_ONLY="${judge_read_only}" where judge_read_only is true only for WAVE_JUDGE, discarding the STALL_JUDGE and RB_JUDGE callers’ AI_ENGINE_READ_ONLY=true setting.
  WHY: STALL_JUDGE and RB_JUDGE consume untrusted PR diffs in a write-profile Claude session with Edit/Write/Bash tools available.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1753-1758 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: For a commit invocation with config_uncertain set, the non-push branch creates a _GuardTarget without the config_uncertain field, so the target flows through to _warn instead of _request_confirmation.
  WHY: A git commit from an unresolvable env -C directory uses the session checkout’s PR history for the guard check, which is the wrong repository.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1593 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF references invocation.config_override, but _GitInvocation was changed to use config_uncertain.
  WHY: If applied, the hunk would raise AttributeError at runtime when the guard processes a guarded git commit or push invocation.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1452-1472 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts ask for all parameterized commands.
  WHY: It does not verify the block path the LAST RUN DIFF indicates was intended.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1419-1433 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts ask for the listed git -c and --config-env commands.
  WHY: It does not verify the block path the LAST RUN DIFF indicates was intended.
- Requirement: "An env -C commit whose directory cannot be resolved requests confirmation instead of using an unrelated checkout's PR history." (from README.md:1123-1124, agents.md:18, changelog.d/6263-push-guard-destination-repo.md:6, LAST RUN DIFF)
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py _evaluate_bash around line 1753, and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py same area
  Evidence of absence: grep for invocation.subcommand == "commit" returns no hits in either hook copy. grep for config_override returns no hits. The guard's _evaluate_bash creates a _GuardTarget for non-push invocations at line 1757 without forwarding config_uncertain, causing the commit to flow through to _warn (warning only) instead of _request_confirmation. The LAST RUN DIFF hunks adding this check (3 lines each to both hook copies) are absent from the worktree. The docs and changelog describe the behavior, but no code implements it.
  severity=critical | confidence=5
- Requirement: "git -c remote.origin.url=..., GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=..., GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS=..., and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=... push commands should be blocked with code 2 (push configuration overrides)" (from LAST RUN DIFF changes to test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs and test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs)
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py _evaluate_bash lines 1759-1761; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py lines 1426-1433, 1452-1472
  Evidence of absence: The production guard currently routes config_uncertain through unknown_destination_reasons to _request_confirmation (ask, not block) at lines 1898-1911. test_per_command_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts ask for every parameterized -c and --config-env command. test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts ask for all GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL commands. The LAST RUN DIFF shows the intended deny path for these categories but neither the guard nor the tests were updated.
  severity=critical | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: poller_claude_judge() defaults judge_read_only to false and does not correctly propagate the caller's intention for STALL_JUDGE and RB_JUDGE.
  WHY: Judges consume untrusted input from the orchestrator's tracking-issue state and may have Edit/Write/Bash tools within the isolated snapshot.

  PROBLEM: The referenced code uses invocation.config_override, which is not a field in the _GitInvocation NamedTuple.
  WHY: Applying this diff hunk will cause an AttributeError when pr_merge_status_guard.py executes.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1755-1757, 1788-1790 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: An unresolved env -C directory for git commit only triggers a warning instead of requesting confirmation.
  WHY: The guard falls back to the session checkout’s branch status when it cannot resolve the commit directory.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1452-1472 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_environment_config_push_asks_without_using_origin_prs still asserts the old ask JSON behavior for parameterized commands.
  WHY: The test does not exercise the described deny/block behavior.
- Requirement: The changes introduced in the LAST RUN DIFF (.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py + workflow-templates twin, 3 lines each) to address PR #6434 must be fully applied and verified.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py around line 1593; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py around the same area; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py at lines 1452-1472.
  Evidence of absence: `grep -F config_override` returns no hits in either hook copy. `grep -F 'if invocation.subcommand == "commit"'` returns no hit
